label: Existing temporal inferences in the Third Way
summary: TERTIA-VIA-SUCCESSION-REQUIRES-INFINITE-PAST derives occupancy at every time up to now as an intermediate conclusion, uses succession to obtain an earlier time, and discharges the succession assumption. TERTIA-VIA-FINITE-PAST-HORN constructs the witness of coming to be anew under its finite-past and temporal premises.
blocker: Applications outside those arguments' temporal assumptions require an explicit match for the clock, occupancy and first-instant coming-to-be conditions.
